questions: Did the hand problem begin suddenly, over hours or a few days?
Does the movement lessen or stop when you are distracted?
Does it change noticeably from one moment to the next?
Can you voluntarily stop the movement, even briefly?
Does moving the other hand rhythmically make the right-hand jerks change or stop?
Does touching a particular part of the hand or arm relieve the abnormal posture?
Did the symptoms begin after an injury, illness, operation, or major emotional stress?
Is the right hand painful?
Do you have weakness or numbness in the right hand or arm?
Do you have difficulty recognizing objects placed in the right hand without looking?
Does the right hand perform actions that you do not intend?
Does the right hand interfere with what the left hand is doing?
Is the right hand slow or clumsy when performing purposeful tasks?
Do you have similar abnormal movements or stiffness in the left hand or either leg?
Do you have a tremor, slowness, stiffness, or reduced arm swing on either side?
Have you developed problems with walking, balance, speech, or swallowing?
Have you noticed worsening memory, judgment, language, or other thinking problems?
Have you ever had a seizure, stroke, head injury, or brain infection?
Did you start or increase any medication before these symptoms began?
Do the symptoms disappear completely during sleep?
